purpose: Routes found while verifying the Taiwan PhD funding landscape that the registry never held. Both are fully funded and neither carries a work-authorisation gate. Later additions from the 2026-09-25 outside sweep are in the same list: HKPFS, SINGA, and the reported job rows.

routes.opportunity: Taiwan International Graduate Program — PhD, English-taught, 12+ interdisciplinary programmes including Social Networks and Human-Centered Computing
routes.contribution_view: Fully funded PhD at Taiwan's national research academy; the strongest stipend found in this sweep
routes.gate: Applications run 1 Nov to 1 Feb for the following Fall; results late June/early July. Confirm programme fit and English test requirements.
routes.origin: found 2026-09-21 while verifying Taiwan PhD funding; absent from every earlier radar

routes.opportunity: Taiwan Scholarship (MOE) — PhD funding, applied for separately from admission
routes.contribution_view: Stackable government funding that does not require an admission offer first
routes.gate: Apply through the TECO in the country of nationality (Indonesia); local offices often close earlier, some in the first week of March. Cannot be combined with university awards that exclude government scholarship holders.
routes.origin: found 2026-09-21 while verifying Taiwan PhD funding; absent from every earlier radar

routes.opportunity: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) 2027/28 — one initial application, then up to two programmes at the eight UGC universities
routes.contribution_view: One RGC fellowship application. Initial deadline 1 Dec 2026 12:00 Hong Kong time. Full university applications the same day, generally 23:59. Results by May 2027. Stipend figure was reported, not copied off the award page in this pass.
routes.gate: Only one initial application per person. Choose at most two programmes. Contact a supervisor before applying. A missing full university application voids the RGC file.
routes.origin: added 2026-09-25 from the outside route sweep; initial deadline confirmed on the RGC page
